program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((target (at g 0 0))
         (choices (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) target)
                                           (not (member? (list 0 0) (obj-cells o)))))
                          (objects g 0))))
    (if (empty? choices)
        (empty-grid 1 1 0)
        (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells (obj-cells (first choices)))))
          (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
